name: frontend-skill
description: Implement production frontend code for websites, web apps, iOS, and Android: components, state, data fetching, forms, accessibility, performance, and client tests, consuming a design handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Production frontend code for websites, web apps, iOS, and Android
interface.longDescription: Implement and review production client code across websites, web apps, iOS, and Android: component and state architecture, routing, data fetching, forms and auth flows, responsive and accessible UI, the full state set, client security, performance, and unit/component/UI tests. Covers React, Next.js, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose, and React Native, and consumes a design handoff (handoff.yaml and DESIGN.md).
defaultPrompt: Use $frontend to build an accessible Next.js signup form with every state and tests.
Use $frontend to implement a SwiftUI settings screen that conforms to the HIG.
Use $frontend to wire a design handoff into a React and Tailwind component with tokens.
